articles.title: French outpost off Canada in the spotlight as Macron hosts Carney on symbolic visit
articles.description: President Emmanuel Macron embarked Saturday on a symbolic visit to Saint Pierre and Miquelon, a French territory off Canada's Newfoundland, where he hosts Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney.
